title: Junior Full-Stack Developer
description: We are seeking a motivated Junior Full-Stack Developer to join our team in Chishtian. You will work alongside senior developers to build and maintain web applications and custom client tools using Node.js, Express, EJS, and modern frontend technologies.
responsibilities: Develop responsive website layouts and template views using HTML5, CSS, and EJS
Build server-side routes, form handlers, and REST APIs in Node.js and Express
Connect and query relational or JSON datasets for web application features
Maintain clean code, fix reported bugs, and collaborate using Git version control
requirements: Degree or diploma in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or equivalent practical experience
Solid foundation in JavaScript (ES6+), HTML5, CSS3, and Node.js fundamentals
Familiarity with Express routing, REST concepts, and basic database operations
Good communication, attention to detail, and willingness to learn on real client projects

title: Digital Marketing & Business Development Intern
description: A 3-month hands-on internship supporting live client campaigns at our agency. You will work closely with our marketing team on social media management, paid advertising, and content creation while gaining practical agency experience.
responsibilities: Assist in managing social media pages, drafting post captions, and scheduling content
Support campaign setup and reporting for Meta and Google advertising accounts
Write engaging blog posts, service summaries, and marketing copy for clients
Track daily engagement metrics and organize client inquiry logs
requirements: Currently enrolled in or recent graduate of Marketing, Business, Communication, or CS programs
Strong written communication skills and interest in digital marketing trends
Basic familiarity with social platforms, Google Workspace, and Canva or graphics tools
Eager attitude to learn agency operations and client management hands-on
